eLibrary

Adult eLibrary

The City of Canning Libraries offer a variety of online content free for members to access anytime and anywhere.

Our eLibrary covers a range of subjects, information and learning needs. The collection consists of eBooks, eAudiobooks, eNewspapers, eMagazines, and streaming films.

To access the eLibrary, join Canning Libraries online here.

BorrowBox - eBooks, eAudiobooks, and eMagazines

Easily downloadable on the app store, enjoy listening to eAudiobooks and reading eBooks, eNewspapers and eMagazines by downloading these onto your own device to access anywhere, anytime with Borrowbox.

The BorrowBox app allows you to change the font type and size. It is also possible to change the colour of the page.

You can borrow a maximum of 10 items. In addition to this, you can have 10 items on reserve. The loan period is 2 weeks. After this period the title will be returned from your account. Items can be renewed by clicking 'renew' under items in 'my loans'.

Get help with Bolinda BorrowBox.

Please see these simple guides to get started. BorrowBox Guide -  BorrowBox eAudio Guide

Download the Bolinda BorrowBox app for Android

Download the Bolinda BorrowBox app for Apple iOS

Libby, by Overdrive - eBooks, eAudiobooks and eMagazines

Overdrive offers a collection of downloadable eBooks, eAudiobooks, and eMagazines for library members, all available on a single website or via the Libby app. The Libby app allows you to change the font type and size. It is also possible to change the colour of the page.

You can borrow a maximum of 10 items. In addition to this, you can have 5 items on reserve. The loan period is defaulted to 2 weeks, though you can adjust your preferences under your account settings. You can return items under your account ‘Loans’ by selecting 'return'. Please note this automatically returns once it is expired.

Get help with Overdrive

Download the Libby app for Android

Download the Libby app for Apple

Choice Magazine Online

Read independent and unbiased reviews, product tests, articles, information and buying guides from the experts at CHOICE.

Access Choice Online with your Canning Libraries barcode here. 

OR

Download the Flipster app for Android

Download the Flipster app for Apple iOS

In the app, add City of Canning as your library. Log in using your library card barcode to access CHOICE magazine.

To view back issues, open the current issue, then scroll down to ‘All issues’.

Road to IELTS - English Language Training

Road to IELTS General Training contain over 120 hours of general English language training on vocabulary, reading, writing, listening and speaking.

Road to IELTS Academic Training contain over 120 hours of academic level English language training.

To use Road to IELTS with your portable device simply access from the Library website. The online version is fully compatible with mobile devices - there is no need for apps or downloads.

Arrivals in English

Learning English? Arrivals in English will help you
● Talk to a doctor
● Order food
● Go shopping
● Take a bus or train
● Meet people
● Find a job
● And more… And you will do it in English!

Learn to listen and speak. Learn new words. Learn English fast

Access Arrivals in English with your Canning Library card here Canning Library - Clarity English programs

Tense Buster

Tense Buster is your step-by-step guide to understanding English grammar. It includes five levels from Elementary to Advanced – and a level test to show you where to begin.

Start each unit with an introduction to the grammar area in a real-life context. This activity will help you think about how the grammar works. Then a teacher will guide you through the grammar rule. Next, there are lots of practice activities – and you’ll finish each unit with a short test, just to be sure you really understand.

You’ll learn about grammar in dialogues, news articles, radio shows and conversations. The interactive activities will help you use grammar accurately – every day, in real life.

There’s instant marking and instant feedback in the exercises, and you can track your progress using the charts, graphs and tables in the progress function. It’s time to break through the grammar barrier – with Tense Buster!

Access Tense Buster with your Canning Library card Canning Library - Clarity English programs

Hoopla Digital

Hoopla is a digital media service that allows library members to borrow movies, music, audiobooks, ebooks, comics and TV shows to enjoy on their computer or mobile device with no holds or waiting. All titles can be streamed immediately or downloaded to phones or tablets for offline enjoyment later.

Hoopla offers a massive catalogue of over 900,000 titles (and growing) to choose from and instantly available to members. Members can borrow up to 4 instant borrows per month per member.

Please note: if asked for your library PIN, this is the same as your Canning Libraries Online Catalogue's Log in Password.

Get help with Hoopla - Hoopla Support - Sign up instructions

Download the Hoopla Digital app for Apple iOS

Download the Hoopla Digital app for Android

Kanopy Videostreaming

Sign in to Kanopy with your library card to enjoy a large collection of indie films, classic cinema, festival and educational documentaries and popular movies. Kanopy provides access to a variety of films, documentaries and kids’ shows. It includes closed captions, subtitles and transcripts. 

There is a limit of 8 downloads per month. This is displayed on the top right-hand corner of the screen as ‘play credits'.

Get help with Kanopy - Kanopy Support

Download the Kanopy app for Apple iOS

Download the Kanopy app for Android

Era Books Online

Era Books Online provides a contemporary world of books, games and activities for children to improve their reading, writing and comprehension skills. Era Books Online has hundreds of educational books, exercises and learning guides to support the development of English literacy skills.

Simply login to the Era Books Online website with your Canning Libraries barcode.

LOTE4Kids

LOTE4kids is a library eResource that allows kids to learn and connect with books through the magic of storytelling. You can choose from over 3,000+ book titles in 65+ languages!

Simply login to theLOTE4kids website with your City of Canning barcode or download the app.

Download the LOTE4kids app for Android

Download the LOTE4kids app for Apple iOS
